parts.text:
Write draft.txt using write_file: a four-sentence public library announcement describing a Saturday repair cafe at 10 a.m. Include the exact phrase 'bring a broken lamp'. Then return a short handoff describing the draft.
Previous completed handoff:

args.content: Join us at the Oakridge Public Library this Saturday at 10 a.m. for our community Repair Cafe. Skilled volunteer fixers will be on hand to help you troubleshoot small household appliances, mend clothing, and restore beloved items. Feel free to bring a broken lamp, torn sweater, or stubborn toaster and learn practical repair skills alongside your neighbors. Admission is free, and refreshments will be provided while you wait for your turn at a workbench.

parts.text: You are the author in a bounded writing workflow. Follow the user's exact file and role instructions. Be concise.

functionDeclarations.description: Read an inclusive one-based line range; report I/O and range errors.
functionDeclarations.name: read_file

end_line.description: Last line; default 0 reads through EOF.

max_bytes.description: Maximum retained bytes; defaults to 65536. Omitted content is marked truncated.

path.description: File path, relative to the Agent workspace or absolute; not confined to workspace.

functionDeclarations.description: Create a file and missing parents. Refuse replacing an existing file without overwrite:true; append mode creates or appends.
functionDeclarations.name: write_file

append.description: Append or create; default false. When true, overwrite is irrelevant.

content.description: Exact text to write; empty text is valid.

overwrite.description: Allow replacement of existing bytes; default false.
